text:
🚨🇲🇽 <u>Trump deports by the planeload — Mexico embraces 271,193</u>

Trump's ICE expels Mexicans by the planeload — up to 600 a week now land in Tulum alone, minors among them. Mexico receives them through "México te Abraza": 271,193 people repatriated in 18 months, each handed a 2,000-peso welfare card, IMSS coverage, and transport home, with 34 federal agencies embracing the very people the empire threw out. (La Jornada)

🇲🇽🎨 The mañanera honors Judith Reyes — the songs the state tried to ban. In "Women in History," the government honored Judith Reyes (1924–1988): the singer-songwriter who turned the corrido into a weapon of memory — chronicling the 1968 massacre, the railway workers and popular struggles the state jailed and censored her for. — "Mujeres en la historia," presented by Noemí Juárez, Aug 27 Every Thursday the mañanera closes recovering women written out of the official story.

🇲🇽⚖️ "Saying 'We Are Mexico' can confuse people — we are all Mexico." "Saying 'Somos México' can confuse society, because we are all Mexico." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the electoral ruling, Aug 27 The electoral authority ordered the opposition group "Somos México" to change its name, emblem and colors. Sheinbaum backed the ruling: a party can't claim to be the nation itself.

🇲🇽🔍 Twelve years on, the state keeps digging for Ayotzinapa's 43. "Before September 26 — twelve years since the disappearance — the FGR may present a public report on new lines of investigation." — Claudia Sheinbaum, after meeting the families, Aug 27 Sheinbaum met the parents of the 43 at Palacio Nacional to brief them on new leads, recent arrests and phone-record analysis. One line touches former Guerrero governor Ángel Aguirre. No case buried; the search continues.

🇲🇽✊ Angela Davis at UNAM: "an institution in the defense of civil rights." "Angela Davis is an institution in the defense of women's rights and civil rights — a woman who has fought her whole life for freedom." She quotes Davis: "What is feminism? Considering a woman a person." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on Davis's UNAM visit, Aug 27 Davis packed UNAM on Aug 26 for the dialogue "Abolition, Feminism, Now!" with Gina Dent and Amneris Chaparro.

🔥🇲🇽 Mexico recovers over $5 million from García Luna's network. "More than five million dollars tied to the Genaro García Luna case — recovered by the state." — Sheinbaum administration, announced Aug 27 The Financial Intelligence Unit traced the funds to the Weinberg family network. García Luna — Calderón's security chief — was convicted in a New York federal court of taking cartel bribes. UIF chief Omar Reyes Colmenares details the recovery Friday.

🚨🇲🇽 "A governor with dual nationality has two interests." "When you hold dual nationality, a governor has two interests. The nation's interest must stand above any other interest of any other State or nation in the world." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on blocking foreign interference, Aug 27 The reform bars would-be presidents and governors from holding a second passport, invoking a foreign nationality, or seeking another country's diplomatic protection — a firewall against injerencia extranjera in Mexican public office.

🇲🇽⚖️ Only Mexicans — with no second passport — may lead Mexico. "Every Mexican who wishes to be president, governor or head of government must be only Mexican — hold no other nationality, nor have acquired one." — Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting the reform, Aug 27 Sheinbaum sent Congress a constitutional reform (Articles 82, 116, 122): candidates for president, governor and head of government must renounce any other nationality before registering, and may not invoke a foreign passport or another state's protection in office.
